This file is for doing data imports 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import our first dataset

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read_csv(file = "data_import_examples/FAS_litters.csv", skip = 0) #skip allows us to skip rows in the csv file

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import our second dataset 

```{r}
pups_df=
  read_csv(file = "data_import_examples/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3) 

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at the data 

```{r}
litters_df 
pups_df
```

Head or tail 

```{r}
head(litters_df, 20) #this shows the first 20 rows

tail(pups_df, 5) # this shows the last 5 rows
```

skimming 

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df) # prints an extended summary of what's going on #able to look at what is missing, what is complete, the mean, sd, outlines of a histogram
```
